selection.name: Living Armor
selection.description: Infuses the target hero or structure with a protective coating which heals the target and provides bonus armor.
selection.differences: Increased heal and reduced cooldown. AI: Prioritizes units who doesn't have the buff. The AI first targets the most frontline unit, then allies within 500 radius, then random allies.

selection.name: Lucent Beam
selection.description: Calls a beam of lunar energy down upon an enemy, damaging and briefly stunning them.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Grants an instant attack at the beam's position towards a nearby enemy in 500 range. Increases Lucent Beam's damage by 100 and cast range by 325. Also reduces mana cost by 50 and cooldown by 3.5.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Calls forth a mini Eclipse, causing beams to bounce 4 times within 675 range, dealing 15% less damage per bounce. Lasts 0.8 seconds.

selection.name: Lunar Blessing
selection.description: Increases the attack damage for Luna and nearby allied heroes. At night Lunar Blessing is global, and Luna is blessed with increased vision range.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Gains +4 damage per round after upgraded.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Grants Bongo Drums: Drums of Endurance passive and active effects, but the attack speed bonus is equal to the Lunar's Blessing damage bonus.

selection.name: Magic Missile
selection.description: Fires a magic missile at an enemy unit, stunning and dealing damage.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Increases damage by 100, breaks for duration of stun and pierces spell immunity.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Bounces infinite times, but only once to each unit.

selection.name: Magnetic Field
selection.description: Generates a circular distortion field of magnetic energy that grants bonus attack speed and protects allied heroes and buildings within it by evading attacks coming from outside the field.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Increases the attack speed bonus by 40, also pushes enemies out of the area when cast, and provides allies in it with +40% Magic Resistance. Slows enemies inside by 30%.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: +200 radius and damage is delayed by 2.5s.
